title: desmodium infractum
intro: Desmodium infractum, commonly known as Zebra grass or Kluai nam, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of D. infractum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
